description: Organised by DMCC, the Dubai Diamond Conference took place on 21 February 2022 at Atlantis, The Palm in Dubai, UAE. The conference brought together industry experts to discuss key topics on the future of diamonds. The event attracted hundreds of industry experts across the precious stone value chain.
